title: EVENTTHING Venue Library — cases.csv
description: One record of `data/cases.csv` (1,309 rows, 14 columns). Empty CSV cells are `null`; numbers are stored as CSV text and MUST be coerced before validation. Encoding: UTF-8 without BOM, LF. See `fields.md`.

case_id.title: case_id
case_id.description: Stable ID derived from the original URL; unique within the file.

venue_id.title: venue_id
venue_id.description: Joins to `venues.public.csv.master_id` where the venue is published; blank when the case is not tied to a venue. A few rows reference venues not yet in the public directory.

venue_name.title: venue_name
venue_name.description: Venue name in Chinese, as published on the source page.

venue_name_en.title: venue_name_en
venue_name_en.description: Venue name in English where the source gives one; blank otherwise.

city_en.title: city_en
city_en.description: City in English where the source gives one.

brand.title: brand
brand.description: Brand credited for the case, as published (bilingual where the source gives both).

brand_en.title: brand_en
brand_en.description: English brand name where the source gives one.

year.title: year
year.description: Four-digit year the case ran, as published.

title.title: title
title.description: Case title in the language of the source (`lang`). No body text is included.

source.title: source
source.description: Publisher name: OnsiteClub or a media outlet. This is not a URL — the link is in `url`.

published_at.title: published_at
published_at.description: Publication date, YYYY-MM-DD, when derivable from the URL; blank otherwise.

url.title: url
url.description: Link to the original; no body text.
